7557969.summary: Opens the Chroma Crate: 62 possible rewards

items.name: Chromatic Sword
lore: Trophy Hunter - claims your victim's head

items.name: Chromatic Mace
lore: Prismquake - shatters the ground around your target

items.name: Chromatic Spear
lore: Prismdrain - every thrust drinks a little life

items.name: Chromatic Bow
lore: Heatseeker - marks your target, looses 2 more arrows

items.name: Chromatic Crossbow
lore: Prismstorm - instant reload, every bolt spits 3 more

items.name: Chromatic Harvester
lore: Prismreap - harvests a 3x3 of grown crops and replants

items.name: Chromatic Angler
lore: Prismcatch - lands a double catch every 15 seconds
